SELECT sku, product_name, count(*) lines, sum(quantity) q, sum(net_amount) net, round(sum(net_amount)/sum(quantity),2) avg_net_unit, min(net_amount/quantity) minu, max(net_amount/quantity) maxu, max(quantity) maxq, count(DISTINCT store_key) stores, count(DISTINCT sale_date) ndays,

WITH sales AS (
 SELECT p.sku, any_value(p.product_name) nm,
  sum(f.net_amount) a_all,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 THEN f.net_amount END) a_notrain,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) a_clean,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) u_clean
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY p.sku),
ret AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) rn, sum(r.quantity_returned) rq
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY p.sku)
SELECT sales.*, coalesce(rn,0) rn, coalesce(rq,0) rq, a_clean-coalesce(rn,0) a_after_ret,
 rank() OVER (ORDER BY a_all DESC) r_all, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a_notrain DESC) r_nt, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a_clean DESC) r_clean, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a_clean-coalesce(rn,0) DESC) r_ret
FROM sales LEFT JOIN ret USING(sku) ORDER BY a_clean DESC LIMIT 14

WITH d AS (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_sales, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns, sum(receipts) r, sum(units_sold) u FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND store_id<900),
f AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) a_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) a_nostaff, sum(f.quantity) u, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) u_ns, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900),
t AS (SELECT sum(net_amount) tr FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999),
rr AS (SELECT sum(refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<900)
SELECT * FROM d, f, t, rr

WITH per AS (
  SELECT period_start_date ps, period_end_date pe FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.ps AND per.pe
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
names AS (
  SELECT sku, arg_max(product_name, valid_from) product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.gross_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net,0) DESC) AS rank,
       sales.sku, names.product_name,
       round(sales.gross_net - coalesce(refunds.refund_net,0), 2) AS net_sales
FROM sales LEFT JOIN refunds USING (sku) JOIN names USING (sku)
ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 12
